title: Lower bound for suprema of bounded families
statement: Let $\iota$ be a type, let $\kappa$ be a nonempty type, and let $g:\iota\to\kappa\to\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0\le g(i,j)\le 1$ for every $i\in\iota$ and $j\in\kappa$. Then the range of the function assigning to each $i$ the supremum of $g(i,j)$ over $j\in\kappa$ is bounded below.
replaced:
Let $\kappa$ be nonempty and let $g : \iota \to \kappa \to \bbr$ take values in $[0,1]$,
i.e.\ $0 \le g(i,j) \le 1$ for all $i, j$. Then the family
$i \mapsto \sup_{j \in \kappa} g(i, j)$ has range bounded below.
